classes.name: AlgorithmMatrix
classes.doc: A-000, the Governor's self-index. One object, several jobs: it indexes algorithms/transformations (known/candidates/unexplored/ history), indexes encountered content (conversation + scrapings), and now hosts five learnin

classes.name: WordAgent
classes.doc: A branch algorithm of the Governor with dominion over one word.

classes.name: Lobby
classes.doc: The Governor's collective sandbox. Part of the Governor's state, not a separate system.

classes.name: LobbyEvolutionGovernor
classes.doc: Governs continuous Lobby evolution toward articulately precise fluency.

classes.name: HypothesisSandbox
classes.doc: The Governor generating, testing, and registering its own algorithms.

classes.name: AyinPerception
classes.doc: Ayin — the perception operator Resh uses to scan the Lobby.

classes.name: ReshIdentity
classes.doc: ר — the Governor's identity anchor.

classes.name: PeCommunicator
classes.doc: פ — the expression and communication operator.

classes.name: CrossLobbyBridge
classes.doc: Maintains cross-lobby ties without touching either lobby's internals. Each bridge is a directed, typed edge: (lobby_a, word_a) → (lobby_b, word_b). The Governor can query any word's neighbors across ALL lobbies in one ca

classes.name: GeneralityMatrix
classes.doc: A-125: The Governor's cross-lobby environment of high-generality vocabulary. Populated by scanning ALL lobbies and copying agents whose generality score exceeds the threshold AND whose entry_class is ABSTRACT.

classes.name: SyntacticalValidator
classes.doc: A-126: Validates whether a candidate generalized statement is syntactically coherent AS A GENERALIZATION — not just grammatically correct, but valid at the level of abstraction it claims to occupy.

classes.name: ValidatedGeneralizationMatrix
classes.doc: A-127: Stores validated propositional understandings — the output of the syntactical feedback loop. Each entry is a coherent generalized statement that has passed validation and is ready to become an Understanding-circle

classes.name: UnderstandingGenerator
classes.doc: Drives the full pipeline: GeneralityMatrix → candidate statements → SyntacticalValidator → ValidatedGeneralizationMatrix.

classes.name: OperationOrderValidator
classes.doc: A-128: Validates that the Governor's pipeline runs in the correct sequence. The bug caught manually: compute_generality_scores() was called before run_orientation(), giving all agents tie_score=0.

classes.name: PoolQualityAuditor
classes.doc: A-129: Audits the Generality Matrix pool for philosophical fitness.

classes.name: CorpusFitnessEvaluator
classes.doc: A-130: Evaluates whether the current indexed corpus is fit for the Governor's current task. Two tasks diagnosed:

classes.name: ThresholdOptimizer
classes.doc: A-131: Finds the generality_threshold that gives the best pool for the GeneralityMatrix — replacing the manual 0.38 → 0.30 tuning.

classes.name: AcquisitionPlanner
classes.doc: A-132: Generates specific corpus acquisition targets from diagnosed gaps.

classes.name: SeedSentenceGenerator
classes.doc: A-133: Generates abstraction test sentences from the Governor's own indexed vocabulary — replacing the manually written SEED_SENTENCES list.

classes.name: PipelineOrchestrator
classes.doc: A-134: The Governor runs its own pipeline autonomously.

classes.name: NumberAgent
classes.doc: A-135: A mathematically manipulatable unit of measure, algorithmically instantiated, indexed as a discovered Law.

classes.name: NumericalIntegrator
classes.doc: A-136: The bridge between the continuous Mathematics Domain and the discrete Computational Domain.

classes.name: LawDiscoveryEngine
classes.doc: A-137: Discovers new Laws from the Governor's Validated Generalization Matrix by formal inference.

classes.name: Variable
classes.doc: An unknown quantity — what the Governor represents when it knows the STRUCTURE of a relationship but not the specific values.

classes.name: AlgebraicExpression
classes.doc: A symbolic expression in the Mathematics Domain — a tree of operations on Variables and Constants.

classes.name: AlgebraicLaw
classes.doc: A-139: A verified algebraic relationship — a discovered Law that holds universally for all valid values of its variables.

classes.name: CalculationEngine
classes.doc: A-140: The Governor executing algebra to produce new knowledge and register working algorithms in its own AlgorithmMatrix.

classes.name: GeneralizationStack
classes.doc: A-141: Given an input word, builds the full abstraction chain — holding every level from the specific input to the most abstract terminal.

classes.name: VGMQuery
classes.doc: A-142: Queries the Validated Generalization Matrix at EVERY level of the generalization stack simultaneously.

classes.name: DescentEngine
classes.doc: A-143: Re-specificizes VGM statements toward the user's input domain.

classes.name: PeComposer
classes.doc: A-144: Composes ECHO's response from descended VGM statements, Ayin's classifications, semantic chains, and gap reports. No LLM. Every word in the response comes from the Governor's own indexed structures or from the use

classes.name: AlgorithmicCommunicator
classes.doc: A-145: The full algorithmic communication pipeline. No LLM. ECHO speaks from its own indexed structures.

classes.name: LogicRule
classes.doc: Named constants for the inference rules the LRM applies.

classes.name: LogicReasoningMatrix
classes.doc: A-146: Generates and stores logical theorems derived from the VGM.

classes.name: FormulaAgent
classes.doc: A-147: A formula as a first-class indexed entity.

classes.name: WebFormulaHarvester
classes.doc: A-148: Autonomously acquires mathematical and scientific formulas from multiple sources. Designed to run with increasing access:

classes.name: FormulaIndexer
classes.doc: A-149: Ingests harvested FormulaAgents into the Governor's matrices.

classes.name: GeneratedAlgorithm
classes.doc: A concrete algorithm ECHO derived from encountering information.

classes.name: InformationAlgorithmizer
classes.doc: A-150: Derives practical algorithms from any new information ECHO encounters. The meta-algorithm — ECHO learning what it can DO.

classes.name: EquilibriumGeneralityMeasure
classes.doc: A-151: Generality measured by blind balancing — G(C) = ΔV/ΔI

classes.name: BalancingScale
classes.doc: A-152: The comparison engine — blind discovery of equilibrium.

classes.name: InwardSearchResult
classes.doc: What the inward search found for a GAP word.

classes.name: InwardSearchEngine
classes.doc: A-153: When Ayin reports a GAP, turn inward.

classes.name: GapReflexMixin
classes.doc: Mixin that adds the inward search reflex to AlgorithmicCommunicator. When Ayin classifies a word as GAP, the reflex fires automatically before that word is written off as unknown.

classes.name: EtymologyEntry
classes.doc: A word's historical root — where it came from before it meant what it means.

classes.name: VocabularyAcquisitionAgent
classes.doc: A-156: Pulls WordNet and etymology simultaneously.

classes.name: DeploymentTranslator
classes.doc: A-157: Reads ECHO's current Python matrix state and produces a JSON blueprint mapping every structure to its Cloudflare equivalent.

classes.name: GeosensoryCrawler
classes.doc: A-158: Semi-open geosensory endpoint discovery and accumulation.

classes.name: SubAgentMatrix
classes.doc: A domain-scoped agentic extension of a Governor AlgorithmMatrix. Owns one region. Knows everything the parent knows (live shared reference), but trusts its own domain signal more heavily.

funcs.name: build_number_matrix
funcs.doc: Instantiate all NumberAgents from the physical and mathematical constants — the Governor's number layer.

funcs.name: make_letter_lobby
funcs.doc: Instantiate a small Lobby for a single alphabet, where each letter is a WordAgent sub-copy of the Governor with dominion over that letter's symbolic and phonetic properties. Letters tie to each other based on shared sema

funcs.name: governor_validate_and_deploy
funcs.doc: The Governor reads A-000 first, validates its own identity, and ONLY THEN deploys sub-agents — one per discovered region. This is the self-indexing closure from the frozen architecture: IDENTIFY(A-000) → VALIDATE(A-000)
